---
name: Signal finding
about: Report a privacy-reviewed observation or stronger independent reference
title: "[Signal] year / ID / field"
labels: research
---

## Generic vehicle context
Year, engine, transmission and market only. Do not include VIN, plate, exact mileage, location or owner identifiers.

## Extraction and proposed meaning
CAN ID, zero-based bytes/bits, endianness, raw values, unit and formula. Mark candidate versus confirmed.

## Independent evidence
Describe the labeled action or diagnostic/physical reference, sample count, timing alignment, tested range and counterexamples. State whether the source data can be reviewed publicly.

## Privacy and safety
Confirm no unreviewed trip log, media, epoch timestamps, absolute odometer bytes or private metadata is attached. Confirm no unsafe fault induction or live experimental vehicle control was used.
